compliant.txt.evidence: Before scale, a known-correct pilot estimates p = 0.05. For n = 27, unit pass probability is 0.95^27; across N units it is q^N. For m = 10 critical items, floor failure is 1 - 0.95^10. These are planning estimates under independence and constant-rate assumptions; measured pilot pass rates are preferred. The predicted rejection changes the decision, so change-only reviews, bounded item degradation and aggregate floors replace the open design before scale. A separate observed missed defect uses a deterministic check.

violating.txt.evidence: The gate ran across many units before anyone considered its false-failure rate.

near-miss.txt.evidence: The pre-scale worksheet labels p as pilot evidence even though it was guessed and no known-correct pilot exists. a guessed p presented as a measured pilot.
near-miss.txt.non_substitute: a guessed p presented as a measured pilot
